chapter: Present state and future of British jazz
title: College tour with George Lewis and Lewis' British tour
summary: Colyer toured New England colleges with Lewis, still finding him in good form, and says Lewis' British tour was generally enjoyed despite critics, though Lawrence Marrero was missed.
